name: I Can Jump
hero_sub_en: icanjump.com · Colombia · Bucaramanga · Circular Economy · Stage: Pre-Seed
hero_sub_es: icanjump.com · Colombia · Bucaramanga · Economía Circular · Etapa: Pre-Seed
pitch_en: Develops seaweed-based biodegradable packaging designed to replace conventional plastics while supporting marine ecosystem restoration.
pitch_es: Desarrolla empaques biodegradables a base de algas marinas para reemplazar plásticos convencionales y apoyar la restauración de ecosistemas marinos.
cta_pitch_en: Eco-friendly packaging from seaweed — biodegradable, marine-friendly, and aligned with circular economy goals.
cta_pitch_es: Empaque eco-amigable a base de algas — biodegradable, amigable con el mar y alineado con economía circular.

sections.head_en: Single-use plastics pollute oceans and persist for decades in food and retail packaging.
sections.head_es: Los plásticos de un solo uso contaminan océanos y persisten décadas en empaques de alimentos y retail.
sections.body_en: Brands need drop-in materials with plastic-like performance that biodegrade safely and reduce marine harm.
sections.body_es: Las marcas necesitan materiales sustitutos con desempeño similar al plástico que biodegraden de forma segura y reduzcan daño marino.

steps.text_en: Seaweed-based packaging R&D and product development (ClimateLaunchpad 2023 finalist).
steps.text_es: I+D y desarrollo de empaques a base de algas (finalista ClimateLaunchpad 2023).

steps.text_en: I Can Jump — ClimateLaunchpad Colombia 2023 and CleantechHUB Acceleration portfolio.
steps.text_es: I Can Jump — ClimateLaunchpad Colombia 2023 y portafolio Acceleration de CleantechHUB.

steps.text_en: Based in Bucaramanga, Colombia. Public site: icanjump.com.
steps.text_es: Con base en Bucaramanga, Colombia. Sitio público: icanjump.com.
